title: Generation ends at a stop sequence
summary: The model reaches a requested stop sequence and reports a normal stop.

messages.content: Count from 1 to 10, then write END, then count to 20.

requirements.text: The library reports a normal stop.
The text is reported exactly as the provider sent it.

grading_notes: Ollama reports stop for both a stop sequence and a natural end. The native request sends options.stop; the OpenAI-compatible request sends stop. Gemini sends generationConfig.stopSequences and reports STOP in both cases, without identifying which sequence matched.
